answer_4.quote: We hired four annotators to improve the quality of the machine-generated translations. Three of the four annotators are native speakers of both Indonesian and local languages... All annotators are well-educated Indonesians (with at least a high school diploma) who have lived in the country for the past 10 years.
answer_4.guideline: Translation verification is the activity of ensuring the correctness of the translation from formal Indonesian to regional languages and/or colloquial Indonesian... Does it match the source text? Are there any translation errors or changes in meaning? Is the grammar and spelling correct?
